task.title: Create a profile from the Library
task.shortdesc: Prepare one named profile in the Library, then open the saved result in Guided editor.

prereq.p: Open Library and know the target Firefox schema, starter preset, and whether a CIS baseline is required.

context.p: Creation is one atomic preparation action. The preparation form collects a name, schema, preset, and CIS baseline; BPM derives the initial policy document and opens the one saved profile in Guided editor. The editor does not choose or replace those baseline identities.

image.alt: Compact Create profile form showing name, Firefox schema, starter preset, CIS baseline, and Create action.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens the compact preparation form.

step.cmd: Enter a distinct profile name, select the Firefox schema, choose a starter preset, and select the required CIS baseline or no CIS baseline.

info.p: The selected schema limits supported policy controls. A preset or CIS choice is a reviewed starting point, not a deployment or compliance claim.
Expected result: BPM creates exactly one server-composed saved profile and opens it in Guided editor.
info.note: If the form reports a name, schema, preset, CIS, or preparation error, no profile is created. Correct the visible choice and submit again; do not try to create profile data outside BPM.

result.p: The Library contains one saved profile with the selected schema, preset, and CIS baseline displayed as read-only facts in each editor.

postreq.p: Recovery: cancel before Create if the intended baseline is unknown. To change schema after creation, use explicit conversion review; to begin from an existing profile, use duplicate preparation.
